final_prompt:

<document>
ok so we're finally hiring!!  Brightline Health is looking for a Data Analyst
to join our care-ops team. you'd be working w/ claims + scheduling data, building
dashboards (Tableau, some SQL), and helping clinic managers figure out where
patients are falling through the cracks.

where: our Raleigh, NC office — it's hybrid, so 3 days in, 2 from home
who: 2+ yrs w/ SQL, comfortable explaining numbers to non-data people
perks: $2,000 sign-on bonus!! plus good coffee, flexible hours, health/dental/vision,
401k match up to 5%, and a team that actually likes each other lol

interested? send your resume + a short note to careers@brightlinehealth.example
by end of month. no recruiters pls
</document>

**Job Title:** Data Analyst, Care-Ops Team
**Company:** Brightline Health
**Location:** Raleigh, NC (hybrid: 3 days in-office, 2 days remote)

**About the role:** You'll work with claims and scheduling data, build dashboards in Tableau, and use SQL to help clinic managers identify where patients are falling through the cracks.

**Qualifications:**
- 2+ years of experience with SQL
- Comfortable explaining data and findings to non-data audiences

**Perks:**
- $2,000 sign-on bonus
- Flexible hours
- Health, dental, and vision coverage
- 401(k) with up to 5% company match
- Good coffee and a friendly team

**How to apply:** Send your resume and a short note to careers@brightlinehealth.example by the end of the month. Recruiters are not being considered.

**Job Title:** Data Analyst (Care-Ops Team)
**Company:** Brightline Health
**Location:** Raleigh, NC (hybrid: 3 days in-office, 2 days remote)

**Overview:** Brightline Health is hiring a Data Analyst for its care-ops team. You'll work with claims and scheduling data, build dashboards, and help clinic managers identify where patients are falling through the cracks.

**Responsibilities:**
- Analyze claims and scheduling data
- Build dashboards using Tableau and SQL
- Help clinic managers pinpoint gaps in patient care

**Qualifications:**
- 2+ years of SQL experience
- Ability to explain data clearly to non-technical audiences

**Benefits:**
- $2,000 sign-on bonus
- Health, dental, and vision coverage
- 401(k) with up to 5% match
- Flexible hours
- A collaborative team

**How to Apply:** Send your resume and a short cover note to careers@brightlinehealth.example by the end of the month. Recruiters will not be considered.
